mentions.name: dnsdist
mentions.description: Version 2.0.0 of dnsdist, now built with nghttp2 instead of h2o. The author notes that compiling it is difficult and that the static-PIE binary with minimum options is 15 MB and keeps growing.
mentions.problem: Compiling the project is never easy, and the static-PIE binary with minimum options is a whopping 15 MB, growing with each version.
